design: Fixed, unoptimized RR mixes. Isolation: 20 identical fresh accounts, no replacements. Operating: start without PAs; monthly current-slot demand and replacements from shared cash-funded RR1 evaluations. PAs copy every exported signal for their assigned RR while flat. Daily minimum withdrawals and 6800 frozen-floor headroom; maximum withdrawal and MFE-first sensitivities are separately labeled. Historical starts overlap and are not out-of-sample validation. Death dates use exported exits; same-signal deaths and interval-overlap bounds prevent interpreting delayed recording as genuine diversification.
